dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing of the lateral margins from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-to-medium grey baseline, indicating a transitional or sub-adult pigmentation phase.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Widespread, high-frequency dark-pixel clusters (mottling) distributed across the entire visible dorsal canvas.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slopes between the darker mottled clusters and the lighter grayscale baseline.
